subject: general
question:
Complete the sentence by choosing the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

When you want to __leave__, you ________ the building.
solution:
The correct answer is '**exit'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Leave" **means to go away from, depart from a place** (दूर जाना, किसी स्थान से प्रस्थान करना)**.

 
 
• Example: She decided to** leave **the party early because she was tired.
 
 
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the blank is** 'exit**'** (किसी स्थान से बाहर जाना)**
 
• **"Exit**" means to go out of or leave a place.
 
 
• Example: Please **exit **the building in an orderly fashion in case of an emergency.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 4.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Move in**: To start living in a place, often by transporting and unpacking goods.** (एक जगह पर रहना शुरू करना)**
 
• **Catch**: Capture or seize, often in order to gain control or possession. **(पकड़ना)**
 
• **Jump**: Push oneself off a surface and into the air by using the muscles in one's legs and feet. **(कूदना)**
